tools.name: list_countries
tools.title: List countries
tools.description: List every country in the Border Energy Index dataset with its price, renewable share, surplus, coordinates and data confidence.

tools.name: calculate_bei
tools.title: Calculate Border Energy Index
tools.description: Compute the Border Energy Index for an exporter/importer country pair, including distance, transmission loss, deliverable energy, price gap and the weighted BEI score.

exporter.description: Exporting country ISO code or name, e.g. 'DE' or 'Germany'.

importer.description: Importing country ISO code or name.

renewableShare.description: Override renewable share of the exported surplus, percent.

priceGapMultiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the raw price gap.

hvdc.description: Simulate HVDC infrastructure (halves the loss rate).

tools.name: rank_trade_pairs
tools.title: Rank cross-border trade pairs
tools.description: Rank every viable exporter/importer pair in the dataset by Border Energy Index score, with a short feasibility rationale for each.

limit.description: How many top pairs to return (default 5).

tools.name: live_carbon_intensity
tools.title: Live grid carbon intensity
tools.description: Fetch the latest live grid carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh) for an Electricity Maps zone code, e.g. 'IN-SO'.
